headline: Expression variation modeled via isoform diversity, donor covariance, and cell-level disease scoring
label: Population Scale Expression Modeling
summary: New preprints extend expression modeling to isoform diversity, within-donor covariance, spatial decontamination and Braak-stage disentanglement in disease cohorts.
synthesis: The common thread is statistical and generative modeling of expression variation to extract structure beyond mean gene-level abundance. One preprint adapts Shannon evenness to quantify isoform diversity across 4,814 GTEx samples, treating it as a distinct expression dimension varying by tissue. IDC contrasts within-donor gene covariance between cases and controls to score disease-associated cells and donor burden. ADVISE, an interpretable generative model, disentangles Braak-stage signals in AD snRNA-seq and prioritizes ROBO2, validated by CRISPRa. PRISM jointly models ambient RNA, doublets and cell-type assignment in spatial data, benchmarked in silico. The head MRI bone marrow adiposity study applies neural-network phenotyping to genetic association, identifying 41 loci, and is adjacent rather than transcriptomic.
